summary.motive: Create wide horizontal stretch with 12-personnel under-center flow to force linebackers to overpursue and open a devastating backside cutback lane.
summary.whyItWorks: The threat of the perimeter reach forces second-level defenders to sprint horizontally; the backside boot fake freezes edge pursuit, creating a massive cutback seam.
summary.failureMode: Backside 3-technique DT shooting the B-gap immediately or playside 5-technique squeezing the reach block before the jump-cut can materialize.

beats.title: 1. Synchronized Zone Reach Flow
beats.text: The offensive line and playside TE fire in unison on 45-degree lateral angles. The back crosses over with rapid horizontal momentum aiming for the outside hip of the left tackle.

beats.title: 2. The Illusory Stretch & Overpursuit
beats.text: The defense reacts to the heavy 12-personnel stretch. The Mike and Will linebackers scrape hard to the boundary to avoid getting hooked, while the backside DE and SS bite on the QB’s bootleg fake.

beats.title: 3. The Vertical Jump-Cut
beats.text: With the frontside defenders hooked and the second-level linebackers overrunning their gaps, the RB plants violently off his left foot and bends back into the wide-open A/B-gap cutback lane.

beats.title: 4. Second-Level Explosive Crease
beats.text: LG and RT finish their second-level climb blocks, sealing off the linebackers and paving an explosive 10+ yard north-south gain right through the heart of the defense.

relations.tell: Full offensive line lateral bucket steps with under-center RB taking the handoff and pressing the tackle landmark rather than QB keeping.
